metaTitle: About TropiNord | Oils & Teas from the Tropics
metaDescription: Discover TropiNord — Nordic standards meet tropical wisdom. We ethically source natural oils and teas from Africa (and soon the South Pacific), supporting small farmers and sustainable practices. Founded in Sweden by Paul Abejegah.
heading: Bridging worlds through the art of care.
subheading: Oils & Teas from the Tropics, refined by Nordic standards.

ourStoryContent.p1: At TropiNord, we believe wellness should connect you to nature, to heritage, and to the wisdom of generations before us.
ourStoryContent.p2: Born in Sweden, we bring the clarity and precision of the Nordic lifestyle together with the deep, time-honoured traditions of Africa. From Sweden’s clean, forested landscapes to sun-warmed tropical soils, every ingredient we choose has a purpose: to nurture, restore, and protect.
ourStoryContent.p3: Sustainability isn’t a trend for us, it is the heart of everything we do. Our products and partnerships are built on:
ourStoryContent.list1: Nordic standards: thoughtful sourcing, clean production, uncompromising quality
ourStoryContent.list2: Global wisdom: ancient herbal knowledge, natural oils and teas, and holistic care
ourStoryContent.list3: Shared responsibility: protecting ecosystems, supporting small producers, honouring heritage
ourStoryContent.p4: This is more than self-care. It’s a connection between worlds — people, planet, and the power of tradition.
ourStoryContent.quote: We’re proud to serve Afro-European customers and friends everywhere, combining African botanical wisdom with Nordic purity.

valuesContent: TropiNord is more than a shop, it’s a community. We empower small producers, inspire eco-conscious living, and help you choose products that are as honest as they are effective. Every purchase supports families, preserves traditions, and protects nature for the next generation.
whatWeDoItem1: Ethically select and share natural oils and fine teas of sustainable origin
whatWeDoItem2: Work directly with small producers and cooperatives in Africa with a roadmap to the South Pacific
whatWeDoItem3: Give local makers and growers the visibility they deserve
whatWeDoItem4: Offer our platform to small businesses and startups so they can grow and reach new customers
whatWeDoExtra: Every product we feature is chosen with care for its purity, its story, and its ability to make a difference.
ourMissionContent: To link tradition, nature, and quality, sharing oils and teas that reflect care, craft, and community. When we take care of the planet, we take care of ourselves.
